name: Tankard of Sobriety

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Drink from it and you never get drunk.
text: This tankard has a stern face sculpted into one side. You can drink ale, wine or any other nonmagical alcoholic beverage poured into it without becoming inebriated. The tankard has no effect on magical liquids or harmful substances such as poison. (No other effect in the game.)
